name: vruum
description: Vruum is a Revenue Operating System for coordinating research, pipeline, outreach, deals, and customer growth from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Vruum is a Revenue Operating System for sales and go-to-market teams. It brings prospect research, CRM records, conversations, deal context, and performance data together so you can spend less time piecing information together and more time moving the right revenue work forward.

Use Vruum from your AI assistant to choose and plan go-to-market motions, research people and companies, source and qualify prospects, build outreach objectives, and review email and LinkedIn drafts. Create LinkedIn content, triage engagement, review deals and their next steps, and turn meeting transcripts into CRM activity and follow-up tasks.

Find warm paths through your relationships, diagnose outreach performance, review pipeline and revenue results, and prepare customer-expansion or win-back plays. Shared records keep the research, evidence, decisions, and outcomes connected across these workflows.

A Vruum account is required. Available data and actions depend on your connected services and workspace permissions. Sending messages, publishing content, and paid activation follow their own approval requirements and workspace policies.
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in Vruum today?
Review my stalled deals and recommend the next action for each.
Review my outreach drafts and suggest improvements before I approve them.
